purpose: Explain remaining desert wet bias and seasonal monsoon errors without changing model coefficients, inputs or physics. Development data only; no adoption or tuning in this diagnostic.
checks: Exact benchmark input identity and scoring footprint
Ordinary T and P benchmark losses reproduce to 1e-10
Recorded source terms reconstruct the recorded steady equation within float32 storage roundoff
All output packets, including adverse findings, are retained
limitations: The column transport is the existing parameterized concentration form; these diagnostics are not source-water tracers, observed evaporation or proof of a closed global budget. Trace ascent terms are nonlinear closure inputs, not additive rain fractions.
